system.description: Creates a physical barrier. Ward strength equals successes. A creature cannot pass unless its Essence exceeds the ward strength (then it tears a hole). Creatures may spend 1 Willpower to assault the ward, rolling Essence dice — each success reduces ward strength by 1, and the creature takes (ward strength × 2) bashing damage soakable only by natural soak. Protects (Degree × 20) feet in any direction.
